purpose: Safely map legacy grammar records into the canonical 15-E schema without inventing exam metadata.
validation_rules: A 1M/2M legacy label may identify a type but must not be treated as official marks unless the source explicitly defines it as marks.
Area/chapter can populate syllabus_unit only when the source explicitly supplies that field.
Missing provenance remains invalid for the blueprint pool.
MCQs require options and an answer.
Every migrated record receives valid=true or valid=false with explicit errors.
release_gate: Only records passing canonical schema validation may enter the blueprint-exact mock pool.
